name: init-project
description: Secure project initialization with UV, hash-backed pip installs, and supply-chain protection.

interface.shortDescription: Initialize projects with UV, hash-backed pip installs, and supply-chain protection.
interface.longDescription: Sets up new projects with UV by Astral as the required package manager, implementing a rolling 24-hour publication delay via uv's native [tool.uv] exclude-newer setting and hash-locked pip exports through [tool.uv.pip] require-hashes/verify-hashes. This skill must be invoked for every project initialization task involving Python.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this project with UV, hash-backed pip installs, and supply-chain protection.
